items.text: Bills ruled DJ Moore OUT (shoulder) for TNF vs Lions after in-game injury/X-rays; Rapoport confirms.
items.why: Shoulder injury + stinger; ruled out mid-game process.
items.implication: Bills WR depth (Kincaid already strong) absorbs targets; Cook usage stable.

items.text: Ladd McConkey DNP second straight day (ribs from Week 1); Schefter: making it unlikely he plays Sunday vs Raiders.
items.implication: Pivot off McConkey; Quentin Johnston and Tre' Harris gain targets/routes.

items.text: Nico Collins hurt hamstring in Wednesday practice (history of multi-game absences including 5 in 2024); DNP Thursday. Routes last week: Collins 37 of 42 Stroud dropbacks (clear alpha). MRI results pending; status in jeopardy for Week 2 vs CIN.
items.why: Hamstring pull in practice + prior history; high route share indicates big target vacuum if out.
items.implication: Monitor Friday designation closely; if OUT, Texans WRs and Schultz rise.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson full practices + 'ready to go' for Week 2 vs PIT after ankle. Still unclear exact split vs Stevenson, but returns at ideal time: AJ Brown IR, desperate for explosives, strong upcoming schedule (PIT/JAX/BUF/LV etc before bye).
items.why: Full practice confirmation + coach/player comments; Brown IR creates opportunity.
items.implication: Henderson flex/RB2 upside in committee; Stevenson still early-down but reduced monopoly.
items.opportunity: Explosive carries/routes in pass game; committee but high ceiling

items.text: Brock Bowers DNP again Thursday due to last week's knee (meniscus) surgery; has yet to practice since procedure. Unlikely Week 2 vs LAC.
items.why: Zero practice post-surgery; coach hopes but timeline points later.
items.implication: Michael Mayer into fringe TE1/streaming role.

items.text: Zay Flowers DNP second straight (hamstring); Ja'Kobi Lane on IR (wrist). If Flowers OUT, Ravens WR hierarchy: Bateman, Devontez Walker, Wester, Sarratt, Moore. Day-to-day but two DNPs lean sit vs NO.
items.why: Consecutive DNPs after Week 1 exit; Lane already IR.
items.implication: Bateman flex upside; more Henry/Andrews volume possible.
items.opportunity: WR target share opens; goal-line/red-zone to RBs/TEs

items.text: Kenneth Walker LOVE Week 2 vs IND: 21/24 RB touches through 3Q (74% snaps), 40% target share on routes Week 1; IND just allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
items.why: Elite Week 1 usage + juicy matchup vs soft run D.
items.implication: Strong RB1/high-end RB2 start; volume locked in.
items.opportunity: 74% snaps, high target rate, goal-line implied

items.text: Ashton Jeanty LOVE @ LAC: 99 utilization score Week 1 (tied Bijan), 19% target share recent, 25+ touches in 3 of last 4.
items.why: Near-max utilization + receiving involvement + recent high-touch games.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 range; workhorse path clear.

items.text: AJ Brown placed on IR with high-ankle sprain; expected miss ~4-6 weeks. Creates immediate opportunity in NE offense already missing explosives.
items.implication: Henderson/Stevenson/Maye stack upside; Doubs etc waivers.
items.opportunity: WR targets open long-term; RB receiving boost

items.text: ETR Week 2 waivers injury beneficiaries: Ladd McConkey out = Tre' Harris; Ja'Kobi Lane IR = Rashod Bateman/Chris Moore; AJ Brown IR = Romeo Doubs/DeMario Douglas; Alvin Kamara return squeeze = Kendre Miller; others include Deebo Samuel context.
items.why: Direct injury replacements with precise hierarchy from practice/role data.
items.implication: Priority adds in order of league size/need; handcuff/backup upside.

items.text: Joe Burrow limited second consecutive day (back); has said he will play vs HOU and called sitting ridiculous if not surgery.
items.why: Limited but player adamant; no surgery.
items.implication: Start as usual; monitor Friday full/limited for any downgrade risk to Chase/Higgins.

items.text: Bucky Irving LOVE vs CLE: RB9 util Week 1, 26% target share, all RB red-zone touches; CLE soft vs rush (121 yds/4.8 YPC allowed); out-routed Gainwell.
items.opportunity: 26% tgt share, all RZ RB touches, routes

items.text: Berry LOVE: Justin Jefferson @CHI (37% tgt share w/ Wentz, career strong w/ him); DeVonta Smith @TEN (27% share, high aDOT, TEN soft); Dak vs WAS (home smash, high total); Dalton Kincaid vs DET (top-5 TE util, 69% routes, DET soft vs TE).
items.implication: Start with confidence; Kincaid TE1, others WR1/QB1 spots.

items.text: Berry HATE: Travis Etienne @BAL (split rushes w/ Miller, air-dependent, Kamara return squeezes, dog script); Marvin Harrison Jr vs SEA (8% tgt share Week 1, 0 RZ, SEA tough vs WR); Brian Thomas Jr @DEN (DEN elite vs perimeter/deep, shoulder limited).
items.why: Role dilution or poor usage + tough matchups.
items.implication: Sit/flex down; pivot to clearer volume.
items.opportunity: Etienne split; MHJ low share; BTJ limited
